_help: Copy this file to ~/.config/atticus/workflow.json and edit it. browser: app name (Google Chrome, Arc, Microsoft Edge, Brave Browser, Safari); leave out to use your Mac's default browser. tools: what you can say after 'open' -> [spoken label, url]. startDay: sites (tool keys, or [label, url]), apps (Mac app names) and openTaskFolder, for 'start my day'. editMode: apps and openTaskFolder, for 'edit mode'. tasks: folder = where task folders live; nameFormat uses {date} {batch} {name} {type}; dateFormat is a strftime pattern; types = spoken word -> label used in the folder name; defaultType; subfolders = created inside each new task folder; exports = label -> folder (relative to the task folder) counted by 'export check'. Remove any key you don't need; missing keys fall back to simple defaults.
